name: Biryani
caption: Ep 7/10 — Lucky shirt pai biryani 😭 Engagement ki 2 rojule! Comment: Bunty ni kshaminchala? 👇 #DostUndiGa #IronDost #Hyderabad

clips.title: The drop
beats: Frame 1 in motion: ultra macro slow motion of a spoonful of red-orange mirchi ka salan and biryani rice falling toward the chest of the navy-blue lucky shirt with thin white checks, worn by BUNTY; warm restaurant lights blurred behind.
Splat: the gravy hits the chest and an orange stain spreads across the checks, a few grains of rice stuck to it.
The view rises to BUNTY at a table for two, frozen, spoon still in the air, staring down at his chest in horror. He grabs a paper napkin and dabs; the stain only smears wider.
BUNTY looks up at someone off camera, forces a huge awkward grin, and covers the stain with the napkin as he speaks.
clips.camera: Starts in an ultra macro on the falling gravy, holds through the splat, then rises smoothly to a medium close-up of BUNTY's face at the table. One continuous move.
clips.sound: Total silence from 0.0 s with a faint slowed-down drip, then a wet splat at 3 s, restaurant chatter and cutlery clinks return at 4.5 s, napkin dab squeaks at 6 s. No music.
clips.first: Ultra macro: the spoonful of red-orange gravy already falling toward the navy checked chest.
clips.last: BUNTY's frozen fake grin, napkin pressed over the orange stain.
clips.edit_text: 0.3 s: 'Lucky shirt. Biryani. Date night.' (big, top third). 7.5 s: kinetic caption 'Ye… design hai.' with a wobbling 'design' sticker
neg_extra: the date's face appearing on screen
a restaurant name, menu text or signage
blood-red liquid that reads as gore

clips.title: Ra Buntyyy!!
beats: Next morning. RAVI, in a grey vest, holds the stained navy checked shirt up against the bright window; the dried orange stain shows clearly in the backlight. His face slowly turns red, a vein rising on his forehead.
RAVI turns his head toward the bedroom door and roars.
BUNTY shuffles into frame on his knees, hands joined in apology, big puppy eyes, and begs.
RAVI glares down at BUNTY, nostrils flaring, the stained shirt still held up beside him. BUNTY shuffles one more step forward on his knees.
clips.camera: Starts on the backlit stain, a quick dramatic push-in to RAVI's red face as he shouts, then tilts down and pulls back to a medium shot of BUNTY kneeling below RAVI. One continuous move.

lines.native: भाई, माफ़ कर. एक दम दिल से.
lines.roman: Bhai, maaf kar. Ek dum dil se.
lines.en: Bro, forgive me. From my heart.

clips.sound: Hanger clink at 0.0 s, a dramatic zoom whoosh at 2.5 s, knees shuffling on the floor at 4.5 s and 8 s. No music.
clips.first: The stained navy checked shirt held up against the bright window.
clips.last: BUNTY on his knees with joined hands, RAVI glaring down with the stained shirt.
clips.edit_text: 2.7 s: 'Ra Buntyyy!!' huge, shaking. 5 s: kinetic caption for the apology
neg_extra: redness that looks like an injury

clips.title: Amma's call and the parcel
beats: RAVI stands holding the stained shirt in one hand; his phone rings and he presses it to his ear with the other, the back of the phone toward the camera. His eyes go wide as AMMA speaks.
RAVI listens, slowly lowering himself to sit down on the floor beside a damp cardboard parcel.
Phone wedged on his shoulder, RAVI pulls open the wet flaps: inside, the maroon Kanchipuram pattu saree with its wide gold zari border and the cream silk pancha, both badly crushed with water marks.
RAVI's face falls; he lifts a crushed corner of the saree and stares at it, mouth open.
clips.camera: Starts in a medium shot of RAVI on the phone, follows him down as he sits, then tilts down into the opening parcel and back up to his falling face. One continuous move.

lines.en: Did the parcel come? The engagement is the day after tomorrow!

lines.native: పట్టు చీర, పంచ, లక్కీ షర్ట్ — అన్నీ రెడీ నా?
lines.roman: Pattu cheera, pancha, lucky shirt — anni ready na?
lines.en: Silk saree, dhoti, lucky shirt — all ready?

clips.sound: Phone ring at 0.0 s, AMMA's voice tinny through the phone, wet cardboard tearing at 5.5 s, a low cello note at 7 s. No music beyond the single note.
clips.first: RAVI lifting the ringing phone to his ear, the stained shirt hanging from his other hand.
clips.last: RAVI on the floor holding a crushed corner of the maroon saree, face fallen, the open parcel in front of him.
clips.edit_text: 1.5 s: 'Engagement: ELLUNDI' pops in red. Kinetic captions for AMMA's lines
neg_extra: a label, address or courier print on the parcel
the saree changing colour or losing its gold border

clips.title: Defeated, and Bunty's idea
beats: RAVI sits on the floor among the crushed saree, pancha and stained shirt, and drops his head into his hands.
RAVI whispers into his hands, shoulders slumped.

The view pulls back and BUNTY comes into the soft foreground, standing in the doorway, looking at RAVI with guilt. He slowly raises his phone; it faces away from the camera and a royal-blue glow lights his face.
BUNTY's guilty face hardens into determination, and a small smile appears as the blue glow brightens. RAVI stays blurred behind him, head in hands.
clips.camera: Slow pull-back from a medium shot of RAVI on the floor, racking focus to BUNTY in the foreground as he raises the phone. One continuous move.

lines.en: The day after tomorrow… everything by then…

clips.sound: RAVI's long exhale at 0.0 s, floor creak as BUNTY shifts at 5 s, an idea 'ding' at 8 s. No music.
clips.first: RAVI on the floor among the crushed silks, dropping his head into his hands.
clips.last: BUNTY's determined, blue-lit face with a small smile in the foreground, RAVI blurred behind with his head in his hands.
clips.edit_text: Cliffhanger at 8 s: 'Bunty ki idea vachindi…' then the end card
neg_extra: any light colour other than royal blue from the phone
